columns.name: Calculation_1264667108401156100
columns.caption: New Timeframe Calc
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Current Sprint" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] = [Calculation_1264667108382490625]

ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Previous Sprint" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] = [Calculation_1264667108382490625] - 1
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Last 6 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] >= [Calculation_1264667108382490625] - 5
    AND
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] <= [Calculation_1264667108382490625]
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Last 12 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] >= [Calculation_1264667108382490625] - 11
    AND
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] <= [Calculation_1264667108382490625]
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Last 20 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] >= [Calculation_1264667108382490625] - 19
    AND
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] <= [Calculation_1264667108382490625]
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Next 2 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] > [Calculation_1264667108382490625]
    AND
    [Calculation_511158595724402688] <= [Calculation_1264667108382490625] + 2
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Current YTD" THEN
    [Calculation_1264667108400721922]
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 9] = "Last Year" THEN
    [Calculation_1264667108400975875]
END

columns.name: Calculation_3427802293734510593
columns.caption: US Target runs success rate
columns.formula:
IF ZN( SUM( IF [REGION_NAME] = 'US' THEN [TARGET_RUN] END ) ) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE
    ZN( SUM( IF [REGION_NAME] = 'US' THEN [TARGET_RUN] - [FAILED_RUN] END ) )

    ZN( SUM( IF [REGION_NAME] = 'US' THEN [TARGET_RUN] END ) )
END
